name: agent-core-packages
description: The packages of other publishers the core's scripts run, each at one exact version, installed from package-lock.json into node_modules/ beside it, which git does not track: by the sync, at a session's set-up and in each job before a check runs (scripts/install.mjs; #654). Nothing of them is carried in the copy. The devDependencies are the references the core's own tests hold its hand-written readers to (tests/readers-test.mjs), installed in the core's own repository alone: a copy installs without them.
